# 2 Baruch Chapter 74 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 74:1 — return of the manna

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "the-treasury-of-manna will-again-descend from-on-high" |
| LOGOS | "the treasury of manna will again descend from on high" |
| PNEUMA | "the storehouse of manna will open again from on high" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Descend' (Syriac: nekhot) accurately describes the heavenly manna descending; PNEUMA's 'open' shifts the image to an opening storehouse, which is not in the source.

---

## 74:1 — consummation of time

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "those-who-have-come-to-the-consummation-of-time" |
| LOGOS | "those who have come to the consummation of time" |
| PNEUMA | "those who have reached the completion of time" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Consummation' (Syriac: shulmana) is the standard eschatological term in 2 Baruch for the end/fulfillment of the age; 'completion' is less technically precise.

---
